regime.summary: Easing cycle: policy rate 10.5% after a 50bp cut, 6M bill 55bp below policy, CPI flat at 5.6%. KSE100 is up 64.4% in 12 months, so the move is mature. Mutual funds are buying while foreign corporates sell. Hold modest weight in cheap fertilizer and E&P leaders, one small muted-price earnings position, and do not chase locked or extended names. Reserves, IMF and current account are not in the pack.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 10.5%; last MPC decision 2025-12-15: cut (-50bp)

evidence.quote: Lesson: favour sectors with their own catalyst over rate-sensitive ones.
